diagnosis: Systemic chronic active EBV disease, liver involvement
legend: The neoplastic cells infiltrate the hepatic sinusoids and portal area (<<29625>>). The neoplastic cells infiltrating the hepatic sinusoids are small to medium-sized and lack cytological atypia (<<29626>>). Immunohistochemistry and EBV-encoded small RNA (EBER) in situ hybridization double staining: some of the EBER-positive cells (brown) are also positive for CD8 (red) (<<29627>>).
